body:
This looks wrong, `k` should not change, see https://pdfa.org/norm-refs/5116.DCT_Filter.pdf (13.1)

> CMYK-to-YCCK uses the same transform as RGB-to-YCC, described
below, on R = (255-C), G = (255-M), and B = (255-Y), where all color
sample values are integers in the range [0.255]. K is passed through
unchanged.

It seems like this conversion isn't needed at all, apparently it may handle converting YCCK images to CMYK pixel data when setting that pixel format. At least removing it fixed the wrongly converted image.

If preferred, instead of this refactoring, the GRAY and RGB cases can be left alone, and only the CMYK/YCCK case would have the full routine to decompress, convert, set the image and return.

The diff would be a bit smaller but the flow would be a bit inconsistent.
